lane: Reference controls, metadata and catalog typography

image_budget.rule: Each job is a fresh fork_turns=none worker. No followup image queues. If a necessary readable crop would exceed this budget, keep that check pending and ask the coordinator for a separate fresh crop job.

root_contracts.title: Show the actual loaded Paperwhite catalog count
root_contracts.requirement: Display a truthful already-loaded or filtered result count from the actual current catalog state. The observed 128 is fixture evidence, not a value to hardcode or a claim about a remote grand total.

root_contracts.title: Keep filter chips at intrinsic content width
root_contracts.requirement: Use intrinsic chip widths with the declared padding and wrapping. Do not flex-grow the last partial row. Preserve actual tags, tri-state semantics, readability and pagination.

root_contracts.title: Use the Paperwhite category-management list glyph
root_contracts.requirement: Restore the Paperwhite list glyph for Category Management. Keep the Scribe folder glyph; Root explicitly distinguished the two profile references.

root_contracts.title: Keep a neutral filter trigger neutral when opened
root_contracts.requirement: Base the settled trigger's applied-state appearance on actual applied filters rather than merely opening the sheet. Preserve ordinary inverse press feedback during an actual press.

root_contracts.title: Use interface sans-serif for Scribe catalog captions
root_contracts.requirement: Render cover-external Scribe catalog captions with the declared interface sans-serif treatment. Do not recolor or reinterpret lettering inside cover artwork, and do not change Library serif titles.
root_contracts.limit: Only the rendered appearance and declared style are asserted, not a measured runtime font file or numeric actual weight.

root_contracts.title: P06 truthful unavailable controls and fixed-on policies
root_contracts.requirement: Accept truthful unavailable presentation and actual fixed-on policy behavior. Do not invent quality, sensor or user-switching features merely to imitate sample enabled states. Keep actual unsupported/omitted control state explicit and do not treat these screenshots as physical hardware qualification.

instructions: Actually open each listed new C5 original candidate and each assigned necessary original reference with tools.view_image. Do not use old C4 candidates or old pixel verdicts in place of new viewing.
Read only compact relevant case/state/metadata/action/log fields; do not dump full manifests, full model arrays, complete oracle payloads or base64 into context/reports.
Use the declared actual state/data and applicable Root contract. Do not demand sample titles/counts or fabricate exact references for new license/editor/empty states.
Closed Reader contains artwork only: no app footer/bookmark/page/status/download/debug chrome. Genuine source-art borders or captions with existing source/oracle identity are not app chrome.

Truthful unavailable/fixed-on controls and absent sensor integration are accepted bounds. Manual270 may replace unsupported sensor-follow without claiming physical qualification. Do not add feature wishes.

Separate directly visible design/state issues from existing captured action/fixture/oracle support. No screenshots prove physical touch, e-ink effects, native mapping, timing or the independent live-reader lease.

Only local static reads and original-image viewing. No application, test, build, probe, local validation/hash/SQL, SSH, copy, crop/image processing, current production/harness/plan edits or new agents.

Write compact English JSON only to the assigned report. Per case include all original evidence SHA, actual viewing, concrete observations, capability/intentional checks and behavior limits. Do not duplicate entire input/state/oracle data.

Immediately report any concrete new actionable, identity mismatch or unreadable detail with exact trigger/current PNG/reference SHA to the coordinator. Keep uncertain observations pending. No full/clean claim.
